chunks.content_en:
## Abstract

Large language models (LLMs) have been increasingly used to interact with external environments (e.g., games, compilers, APIs) as goal-driven agents. However, it remains challenging for these language agents to quickly and efficiently learn from trial-and-error as traditional reinforcement learning methods require extensive training samples and expensive model fine-tuning. We propose Reflexion, a novel framework to reinforce language agents not by updating weights, but instead through linguistic feedback.
chunks.content_zh:
##  摘要

大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用作目标驱动型智能体，与外部环境（如游戏、编译器、API）进行交互。然而，这些语言智能体仍难以快速高效地从试错中学习，因为传统强化学习方法需要大量训练样本，并且模型微调成本高昂。我们提出 Reflexion，一种新颖的框架，不是通过更新权重，而是通过语言反馈来强化语言智能体。

chunks.content_en:
## Abstract

Concretely, Reflexion agents verbally reflect on task feedback signals, then maintain their own reflective text in an episodic memory buffer to induce better decision-making in subsequent trials. Reflexion is flexible enough to incorporate various types (scalar values or free-form language) and sources (external or internally simulated) of feedback signals, and obtains significant improvements over a baseline agent across diverse tasks (sequential decision-making, coding, language reasoning).
chunks.content_zh: 具体而言，Reflexion 智能体会以语言形式对任务反馈信号进行反思，然后将自己的反思文本保存在情景记忆缓冲区（episodic memory buffer）中，以在后续尝试中促成更好的决策。Reflexion 足够灵活，能够纳入各种类型（标量值或自由形式语言）和来源（外部或内部模拟）的反馈信号，并在多种任务（序列决策、编程、语言推理）中相较基线智能体取得了显著提升。

chunks.content_en:
## Abstract

For example, Reflexion achieves a 91% pass@1 accuracy on the HumanEval coding benchmark, surpassing the previous state-of-the-art GPT-4 that achieves 80%. We also conduct ablation and analysis studies using different feedback signals, feedback incorporation methods, and agent types, and provide insights into how they affect performance. We release all code, demos, and datasets at https://github.com/noahshinn024/reflexion.
chunks.content_zh: 例如，Reflexion 在 HumanEval 编码基准上达到了 91% 的 pass@1 准确率，超过了此前最先进的 GPT-4 所达到的 80%。我们还使用不同的反馈信号、反馈整合方法和智能体类型进行了消融与分析研究，并提供了它们如何影响性能的见解。我们在 https://github.com/noahshinn024/reflexion 发布了所有代码、演示和数据集。

chunks.content_en:
## 1 Introduction

Recent works such as ReAct [ 30], SayCan [ 1], Toolformer [ 22], HuggingGPT [ 23], generative agents [19], and WebGPT [17] have demonstrated the feasibility of autonomous decision-making agents that are built on top of a large language model (LLM) core. These methods use LLMs to generate text and ‘actions‘ that can be used in API calls and executed in an environment.
chunks.content_zh:
## 1 引言

近期工作如 ReAct [30]、SayCan [1]、Toolformer [22]、HuggingGPT [23]、生成式智能体（generative agents）[19] 和 WebGPT [17] 已经证明了基于大语言模型（LLM）核心构建自主决策智能体（Agent）的可行性。这些方法使用 LLM 生成文本和“动作”（actions），这些动作可用于 API 调用并在环境中执行。

chunks.content_en:
## 1 Introduction

Since they rely on massive models with an enormous number of parameters, such approaches have been so far limited to using in-context examples as a way of teaching the agents, since more traditional optimization schemes like reinforcement learning with gradient descent require substantial amounts of compute and time.
chunks.content_zh:
## 1 引言

由于这些方法依赖具有海量参数的庞大模型，迄今为止它们仅限于使用上下文示例（in-context examples）来教导智能体，因为诸如带梯度下降的强化学习等更传统的优化方案需要大量的计算和时间。

chunks.content_en:
## 1 Introduction

In this paper, we propose an alternative approach called Reflexion that uses verbal reinforcement to help agents learn from prior failings. Reflexion converts binary or scalar feedback from the environment into verbal feedback in the form of a textual summary, which is then added as additional context for the LLM agent in the next episode.
chunks.content_zh:
## 1 引言

在本文中，我们提出了一种名为 Reflexion 的替代方法，该方法使用言语强化来帮助智能体从先前的失败中学习。Reflexion 将来自环境的二元或标量反馈转换为文本摘要形式的言语反馈，然后在下一回合（episode）中作为额外上下文添加到 LLM 智能体。

chunks.content_en:
## 1 Introduction

This self-reflective feedback acts as a ‘semantic’ gradient signal by providing the agent with a concrete direction to improve upon, helping it learn from prior mistakes to perform better on the task. This is akin to how humans iteratively learn to accomplish complex tasks in a few-shot manner – by reflecting on their previous failures in order to form an improved plan of attack for the next attempt.
chunks.content_zh:
## 1 引言

这种自我反思反馈充当一种“语义”梯度信号，为智能体（agent）提供了具体的改进方向，帮助它从先前的错误中学习，从而在任务中表现得更好。这类似于人类以少样本（few-shot）方式迭代学习完成复杂任务——通过反思自己先前的失败，为下一次尝试制定改进的行动方案。

## 1 Introduction

For example, in figure 1, a Reflexion agent learns to optimize its own behavior to solve decision-making, programming, and reasoning tasks through trial, error, and self-reflection. Generating useful reflective feedback is challenging since it requires a good understanding of where the model made mistakes (i.e. the credit assignment problem [25]) as well as the ability to generate a summary containing actionable insights for improvement.

chunks.content_en:
## 1 Introduction

We explore three ways for doing this – simple binary environment feedback, pre-defined heuristics for common failure cases, and self-evaluation such as binary classification using LLMs (decision-making) or self-written unit tests (programming). In all implementations, the evaluation signal is amplified to natural language experience summaries which can be stored in long-term memory.
chunks.content_zh:

我们探索了三种实现方式——简单的二元环境反馈、针对常见失败情况的预定义启发式规则，以及自我评估，例如使用 LLM 进行二元分类（决策）或自编单元测试（编程）。在所有实现中，评估信号被放大为自然语言经验摘要，可存储于长期记忆（long-term memory）中。

chunks.content_en:
## 1 Introduction

However, as LLM capabilities improve, we only expect this paradigm to get better over time. We perform experiments on (1) decision-making tasks to test sequential action choices over long trajectories, (2) reasoning tasks to test knowledge-intensive, single-step generation improvement, and (3) programming tasks to teach the agent to effectively use external tools such as compilers and interpreters.
chunks.content_zh:
## 1 引言

然而，随着LLM能力的提升，我们只会预期这一范式会随着时间推移而不断改善。我们在以下任务上进行了实验：（1）决策任务，用于测试长轨迹上的序贯动作选择；（2）推理任务，用于测试知识密集型的单步生成改进；以及（3）编程任务，用于教会智能体有效使用编译器和解释器等外部工具。

chunks.content_en:
## 1 Introduction

Across all three types of tasks, we observe Reflexion agents are better decisionmakers, reasoners, and programmers. More concretely, Reflexion agents improve on decision-making AlfWorld [24] tasks over strong baseline approaches by an absolute 22% in 12 iterative learning steps, and on reasoning questions in HotPotQA [ 28] by 20%, and Python programming tasks on HumanEval [6] by as much as 11%.
chunks.content_zh:
## 1 引言

在所有三类任务中，我们观察到 Reflexion 智能体是更优秀的决策者、推理者和程序员。更具体地说，Reflexion 智能体在 AlfWorld [24] 决策任务上，经过 12 个迭代学习步骤，相较于强基线方法绝对提升了 22%；在 HotPotQA [28] 的推理问题上提升了 20%；在 HumanEval [6] 的 Python 编程任务上提升幅度高达 11%。

chunks.content_en:
## 1 Introduction

To summarize, our contributions are the following: • We propose Reflexion, a new paradigm for ‘verbal‘ reinforcement that parameterizes a policy as an agent’s memory encoding paired with a choice of LLM parameters. • We explore this emergent property of self-reflection in LLMs and empirically show that self-reflection is extremely useful to learn complex tasks over a handful of trials.
chunks.content_zh:
## 1 引言

总而言之，我们的贡献如下：• 我们提出了 Reflexion，这是一种“言语”强化新范式，将策略参数化为智能体的记忆编码，并与所选择的 LLM 参数相结合。• 我们探索了 LLM 中自我反思这一涌现特性，并通过实验表明，自我反思对于在少量试验中学习复杂任务极为有用。

chunks.content_en:
## 1 Introduction

• We introduce LeetcodeHardGym, a code-generation RL gym environment consisting of 40 challenging Leetcode questions (‘hard-level‘) in 19 programming languages. • We show that Reflexion achieves improvements over strong baselines across several tasks, and achieves state-of-the-art results on various code generation benchmarks.

Kim et al. [10] use a retry pattern over a fixed number of steps without an evaluation step. Goodman [9] perform a qualitative evaluation step that proposes optimizations to the previous generation. In this paper, we show that several of these concepts can be enhanced with self-reflection to build a persisting memory of self-reflective experiences which allows an agent to identify its own errors and self-suggest lessons to learn from its mistakes over time.

## 2 相关工作

Kim等人[10]在固定步数上使用重试模式，但没有评估步骤。Goodman [9]执行了一个定性评估步骤，对上一代生成提出优化建议。在本文中，我们表明，这些概念中的若干可以通过自我反思（self-reflection）加以增强，以构建一个持久的自我反思经验记忆，使智能体（agent）能够识别自身错误，并自我提出经验教训，从而随时间推移从错误中学习。

## 3 Reflexion: reinforcement via verbal reflection

We develop a modular formulation for Reflexion, utilizing three distinct models: an Actor, denoted as Ma, which generates text and actions; anEvaluator model, represented by Me, that scores the outputs produced by Ma; and a Self-Reflection model, denoted as Msr, which generates verbal reinforcement cues to assist the Actor in self-improvement. We provide a detailed description of each of these models and subsequently elucidate their collaborative functioning within the Reflexion framework.

## 3 Reflexion: reinforcement via verbal reflection

It takes as input a generated trajectory and computes a reward score that reflects its performance within the given task context. Defining effective value and reward functions that apply to semantic spaces is difficult, so we investigate several variants of the Evaluator model. For reasoning tasks, we explore reward functions based on exact match (EM) grading, ensuring that the generated output aligns closely with the expected solution.
chunks.content_zh:
## 3 Reflexion：通过言语反思进行强化

它接受一条生成的轨迹（trajectory）作为输入，并计算一个奖励分数，以反映其在给定任务上下文中的表现。由于定义适用于语义空间的有效价值函数和奖励函数很困难，因此我们研究了评估器模型（Evaluator）的几种变体。对于推理任务，我们探索基于精确匹配（EM）评分的奖励函数，确保生成的输出与预期解高度一致。

chunks.content_en:
## 3 Reflexion: reinforcement via verbal reflection

In decision-making tasks, we employ pre-defined heuristic functions that are tailored to specific evaluation criteria. Additionally, we experiment with using a different instantiation of an LLM itself as an Evaluator, generating rewards for decision-making and programming tasks. This multi-faceted approach to Evaluator design allows us to examine different strategies for scoring generated outputs, offering insights into their effectiveness and suitability across a range of tasks.
chunks.content_zh:
## 3 Reflexion：通过语言反思进行强化

在决策任务中，我们采用针对特定评估标准量身定制的预定义启发式函数。此外，我们还尝试使用一个不同实例化的 LLM 本身作为 Evaluator，为决策和编程任务生成奖励。这种多方面的 Evaluator 设计方法使我们能够考察对生成输出进行评分的不同策略，从而深入理解它们在各种任务中的有效性和适用性。

chunks.content_en:
## 3 Reflexion: reinforcement via verbal reflection

Self-reflection The Self-Reflection model instantiated as an LLM, plays a crucial role in the Reflexion framework by generating verbal self-reflections to provide valuable feedback for future trials. Given a sparse reward signal, such as a binary success status (success/fail), the current trajectory, and its persistent memory mem, the self-reflection model generates nuanced and specific feedback. This feedback, which is more informative than scalar rewards, is then stored in the agent’s memory (mem).
chunks.content_zh:
## 3 Reflexion：通过言语反思进行强化

自我反思（Self-reflection） Self-Reflection 模型以 LLM 实例化，在 Reflexion 框架中起着至关重要的作用，它生成言语自我反思，为未来尝试提供有价值的反馈。给定稀疏奖励信号，例如二元的成功状态（success/fail）、当前轨迹及其持久记忆 mem，自我反思模型会生成细致且具体的反馈。这种比标量奖励更具信息量的反馈随后被存储在智能体的记忆（mem）中。

chunks.content_en:
## 3 Reflexion: reinforcement via verbal reflection

For instance, in a multi-step decision-making task, when the agent receives a failure signal, it can infer that a specific action ai led to subsequent incorrect actions ai+1 and ai+2. The agent can then verbally state that it should have taken a different action, a′ i, which would have resulted in a′ i+1 and a′ i+2, and store this experience in its memory. In subsequent trials, the agent can leverage its past experiences to adapt its decision-making approach at time t by choosing action a′ i.
chunks.content_zh:
## 3 Reflexion：通过语言反思进行强化

例如，在多步决策任务中，当智能体（agent）收到失败信号时，它可以推断出某个特定动作 \(a_i\) 导致了后续的错误动作 \(a_{i+1}\) 和 \(a_{i+2}\)。然后，智能体可以用语言表述：它本应采取一个不同的动作 \(a'_i\)，这样就会产生 \(a'_{i+1}\) 和 \(a'_{i+2}\)，并将这一经验存储到记忆中。在后续尝试中，智能体可以利用过去的经验，在时间 \(t\) 通过选择动作 \(a'_i\) 来调整其决策方式。

chunks.content_en:

to the way that humans remember fine-grain recent details while also recalling distilled important experiences from long-term memory. In the RL setup, the trajectory history serves as the short-term memory while outputs from the Self-Reflection model are stored in long-term memory. These two memory components work together to provide context that is specific but also influenced by lessons learned over several trials, which is a key advantage of Reflexion agents over other LLM action choice works.
chunks.content_zh:
## 3 Reflexion：通过言语反思进行强化

与人类既记住近期的细粒度细节，又从长期记忆中回忆提炼出的重要经验的方式类似。在强化学习设置中，轨迹历史充当短期记忆，而 Self-Reflection 模型的输出则存储在长期记忆中。这两个记忆组件协同工作，提供既具体又受多次试验中所学教训影响的上下文，这是 Reflexion 智能体相较于其他 LLM 动作选择工作的一个关键优势。

chunks.content_en:
## 3 Reflexion: reinforcement via verbal reflection

The Reflexion process Reflexion is formalized as an iterative optimization process in 1. In the first trial, the Actor produces a trajectory τ0 by interacting with the environment. The Evaluator then produces a score r0 which is computed as rt = Me(τ0). rt is only a scalar reward for trial t that improves as task-specific performance increases.
chunks.content_zh:
## 3 Reflexion：通过语言反思进行强化

Reflexion 过程 Reflexion 在 1 中被形式化为一个迭代优化过程。在第一次尝试中，Actor 通过与环境交互产生一条轨迹 τ0。随后 Evaluator 产生一个分数 r0，其计算方式为 rt = Me(τ0)。rt 仅是第 t 次尝试的标量奖励，随着任务特定性能的提高而提高。

chunks.content_en:
## 3 Reflexion: reinforcement via verbal reflection

After the first trial, to amplify r0 to a feedback form that can be used for improvement by an LLM, the Self-Reflection model analyzes the set of {τ0, r0} to produce a summary sr0 which is stored in the memory mem. srt is a verbal experience feedback for trial t. The Actor, Evaluator, and Self-Reflection models work together through trials in a loop until the Evaluator deems τt to be correct. As mentioned in 3, the memory component of Reflexion is crucial to its effectiveness.
chunks.content_zh:
## 3 Reflexion：通过语言反思进行强化

在第一次试验之后，为了将 r0 放大为可供 LLM 用于改进的反馈形式，Self-Reflection 模型分析集合 {τ0, r0}，生成摘要 sr0，并将其存储在记忆 mem 中。srt 是第 t 次试验的语言经验反馈。Actor、Evaluator 和 Self-Reflection 模型在循环中通过多次试验协同工作，直到 Evaluator 判定 τt 正确为止。如第 3 节所述，Reflexion 的记忆组件对其有效性至关重要。

chunks.content_en:
## 3 Reflexion: reinforcement via verbal reflection

After each trial t, srt, is appended mem. In practice, we bound mem by a maximum number of stored experiences, Ω (usually set to 1-3) to adhere to max context LLM limitations.
chunks.content_zh:
## 3 Reflexion：通过语言反思进行强化

每次试验 t 后，srt 被追加到 mem。在实践中，我们将 mem 限制为最大存储经验数 Ω（通常设为 1-3），以遵守最大上下文 LLM 限制。

## 4 Experiments

We evaluate various natural language RL setups on decision-making, reasoning, and code generation tasks. Specifically, we challenge an agent to perform search-based question answering on HotPotQA [28], multi-step tasks in common household environments in AlfWorld [24], and code writing tasks in competition-like environments with interpreters and compilers in HumanEval [ 6], MBPP [ 2], and LeetcodeHard, a new benchmark.
chunks.content_zh:
## 4 实验

我们评估了多种自然语言强化学习（RL）设置，涵盖决策、推理和代码生成任务。具体而言，我们要求智能体在 HotPotQA [28] 上执行基于搜索的问答，在 AlfWorld [24] 中的常见家庭环境里完成多步任务，并在 HumanEval [ 6]、MBPP [ 2] 以及新基准 LeetcodeHard 等带有解释器和编译器的类竞赛环境中完成代码编写任务。

chunks.content_en:
## 4 Experiments

Most notably, Reflexion improves performance over strong baselines by 22% in AlfWorld, 20% in HotPotQA, and 11% on HumanEval.
chunks.content_zh:
## 4 实验

最值得注意的是，Reflexion 相比强基线在 AlfWorld 中性能提升 22%，在 HotPotQA 中提升 20%，在 HumanEval 上提升 11%。

chunks.content_en:
## 4.1 Sequential decision making: ALFWorld

AlfWorld is a suite of text-based environments that challenge an agent to solve multi-step tasks in a variety of interactive environments based on TextWorld [ 8]. Following Yao et al. [30], we run the agent in 134 AlfWorld environments across six different tasks, including finding hidden objects (e.g., finding a spatula in a drawer), moving objects (e.g., moving a knife to the cutting board), and manipulating objects with other objects (e.g., chilling a tomato in the fridge).
chunks.content_zh:
## 4.1 序贯决策：ALFWorld

ALFWorld 是一套基于文本的环境，挑战智能体在多种基于 TextWorld [8] 的交互式环境中解决多步骤任务。遵循 Yao 等人 [30] 的做法，我们在 134 个 ALFWorld 环境中运行智能体，涵盖六种不同任务，包括寻找隐藏物品（例如在抽屉里找锅铲）、移动物品（例如把刀移到砧板上），以及使用其他物品操作物品（例如在冰箱里冷藏西红柿）。

chunks.content_en:
## 4.1 Sequential decision making: ALFWorld

We use ReAct [30] as the action generator as Yao et al. [30] has shown success in long trajectory decisionmaking using explicit intermediate thoughts. AlfWorld tasks naturally require a self-evaluation step as the environment can only signal if a task is complete. To achieve fully autonomous behavior, we implement two self-evaluation techniques: natural language classification using an LLM and a hand-written heuristic.
chunks.content_zh:
## 4.1 顺序决策：ALFWorld

我们使用 ReAct [30] 作为动作生成器，因为 Yao 等人 [30] 已证明通过显式中间思考在长轨迹决策中取得成功。AlfWorld 任务自然需要自我评估步骤，因为环境只能提示任务是否完成。为了实现完全自主的行为，我们实现了两种自我评估技术：使用 LLM 的自然语言分类和手写启发式方法。

chunks.content_en:
## 4.1 Sequential decision making: ALFWorld

The heuristic is simple: if the agent executes the same action and receives the same response for more than 3 cycles, or if the number of actions taken in the current environment exceeds 30 (inefficient planning), we self-reflect. In the baseline runs, if self-reflection is suggested, we skip the self-reflection process, reset the environment, and start a new trial. In the Reflexion runs, the agent uses self-reflection to find its mistake, update its memory, reset the environment, and start a new trial.
chunks.content_zh:
## 4.1 顺序决策：ALFWorld

启发式规则很简单：如果智能体执行相同动作并收到相同响应超过 3 个周期，或者在当前环境中采取的动作数量超过 30（低效规划），我们就进行自我反思。在基线运行中，如果建议进行自我反思，我们会跳过自我反思过程，重置环境，并开始新的试验。在 Reflexion 运行中，智能体使用自我反思来发现其错误，更新其记忆，重置环境，并开始新的试验。

chunks.content_en:
## 4.1 Sequential decision making: ALFWorld

To avoid very long prompt windows that may exceed the maximum limit, we truncate the agent’s memory to the last 3 self-reflections (experiences). To avoid syntactic errors, we provide two domain-specific few-shot trajectories to the agent. We use the same few-shot trajectory examples as Yao et al.[30] with GPT-3 for the LLM. AlfWorld tasks, ReAct few-shot prompts, and Reflexion examples are included in the appendix.
chunks.content_zh:
## 4.1 序贯决策：ALFWorld

为避免提示窗口过长而可能超出最大限制，我们将智能体的记忆截断为最近 3 条自我反思（经验）。为避免语法错误，我们向智能体提供两条领域特定的少样本轨迹。我们使用与 Yao 等人[30] 相同的少样本轨迹示例，并采用 GPT-3 作为 LLM。ALFWorld 任务、ReAct 少样本提示和 Reflexion 示例均包含在附录中。

## 4.1 Sequential decision making: ALFWorld

## 4.2 Reasoning: HotpotQA

HotPotQA [28] is a Wikipedia-based dataset with 113k question-and-answer pairs that challenge agents to parse content and reason over several supporting documents. To test improvement in reasoning only ability, we implement Reflexion + Chain-of-Thought (CoT) [ 26] for step-by-step Q → A and Q, Cgt → A implementations, where Q is the question, Cgt is the ground truth context from the dataset, and A is the final answer.
chunks.content_zh:
## 4.2 推理：HotpotQA

HotPotQA [28] 是一个基于维基百科的数据集，包含 113k 个问答对，要求智能体解析内容并基于多个支持文档进行推理。为了仅测试推理能力的提升，我们实现了 Reflexion + 思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）[26]，用于逐步 Q → A 和 Q, Cgt → A 的实现，其中 Q 是问题，Cgt 是数据集中的真实上下文，A 是最终答案。

chunks.content_en:
## 4.2 Reasoning: HotpotQA

Since CoT is not a multi-step decision-making technique, we give Cgt to the agent so that we can isolate the reasoning behavior over large sections of the provided text. To test holistic question and answering ability, which requires reasoning and action choice, we implement a Reflexion + ReAct [ 30] agent that can retrieve relevant context using a Wikipedia API and infer answers using step-by-step explicit thinking.
chunks.content_zh:
## 4.2 推理：HotpotQA

由于 CoT 不是一种多步决策技术，我们将 Cgt 提供给智能体，以便我们可以在所提供文本的大段内容上隔离推理行为。为了测试整体问答能力（这需要推理和行动选择），我们实现了一个 Reflexion + ReAct [30] 智能体，它可以使用 Wikipedia API 检索相关上下文，并通过逐步显式思考来推断答案。

chunks.content_en:
## 4.2 Reasoning: HotpotQA

For CoT implementations, we use 6-shot prompting; for ReAct, we use 2-shot prompting, and for self-reflection, we use 2-shot prompting. All examples can be found in the appendix. Robustly evaluating natural language answers is a long-standing problem in NLP. Therefore, between trials, we use exact match answer grading using the environment to give a binary success signal to the agent.
chunks.content_zh:
## 4.2 推理：HotpotQA

对于 CoT 实现，我们使用 6-shot 提示；对于 ReAct，我们使用 2-shot 提示；对于自我反思（self-reflection），我们使用 2-shot 提示。所有示例可在附录中找到。稳健地评估自然语言答案在 NLP 中是一个长期存在的问题。因此，在试验之间，我们使用环境进行精确匹配（exact match）答案评分，以向智能体（agent）提供一个二元成功信号。

chunks.content_en:

After each trial, the self-reflection loop is employed to amplify the binary signal, similar to the decision-making setup 4.1 in AlfWorld with a memory size of 3 experiences. Results Reflexion outperforms all baseline approaches by significant margins over several learning steps.

## 4.2 Reasoning: HotpotQA

Recall that CoT (GT) uses Chain-of-Thought reasoning with provided ground truth context, which tests reasoning ability over long contexts. ## 4.2 推理：HotpotQA

chunks.content_en:
## 5 Limitations

At its core, Reflexion is an optimization technique that uses natural language to do policy optimization. Policy optimization is a powerful approach to improve action choice through experience, but it may still succumb to non-optimal local minima solutions. In this study, we limit long-term memory to a sliding window with maximum capacity, but we encourage future work to extend the memory component of Reflexion with more advanced structures such as vector embedding databases or traditional SQL databases.
chunks.content_zh:
## 5 局限性

就其核心而言，Reflexion 是一种利用自然语言进行策略优化（policy optimization）的优化技术。策略优化是一种通过经验改进动作选择的强大方法，但仍可能陷入非最优的局部最优解。在本研究中，我们将长期记忆限制为具有最大容量的滑动窗口，但我们鼓励未来工作用更先进的结构扩展 Reflexion 的记忆组件，例如向量嵌入数据库或传统 SQL 数据库。

chunks.content_en:
## 5 Limitations

Specific to code generation, there are many practical limitations to testdriven development in specifying accurate input-output mappings such as non-deterministic generator functions, impure functions that interact with APIs, functions that vary output according to hardware specifications, or functions that invoke parallel or concurrent behavior that may be difficult to predict.
chunks.content_zh:
## 5 局限性

具体到代码生成，测试驱动开发在指定精确的输入-输出映射方面存在许多实际局限，例如非确定性生成器函数、与 API 交互的非纯函数、根据硬件规格而产生不同输出的函数，或调用可能难以预测的并行或并发行为的函数。

chunks.content_en:
## 6 Broader impact

Large language models are increasingly used to interact with external environments (e.g. the Internet, software, robotics, etc.) and humans. Our work has the potential of reinforcing and empowering these agents toward greater automation and work efficiency, but it also amplifies the risks when these agents were put into misuse. We believe that this direction of research will need more effort in safety and ethical considerations.
chunks.content_zh:
## 6 更广泛的影响

大语言模型正越来越多地被用于与外部环境（例如互联网、软件、机器人等）以及人类进行交互。我们的工作有潜力强化和赋能这些智能体（agent），使其实现更高的自动化和工作效率，但同时也会在这些智能体被误用时放大风险。我们认为，这一研究方向需要在安全性和伦理考量上投入更多努力。

chunks.content_en:
## 6 Broader impact

On the other hand, reinforcement learning has suffered from its black-box policy and optimization setups in which interpretability and alignment have been challenging. Our proposed “verbal” reinforcement learning might address some of the issues and turn autonomous agents more interpretable and diagnosable. For example, in the case of tool-usage that may be too hard for humans to understand, self-reflections could be monitored to ensure proper intent before using the tool.
chunks.content_zh:
## 6 更广泛的影响

另一方面，强化学习一直受困于其黑盒策略和优化设置，使得可解释性和对齐变得困难。我们提出的“语言化”（verbal）强化学习可能有助于解决其中一些问题，并使自主智能体更具可解释性和可诊断性。例如，在人类可能难以理解的工具使用情形中，可以在使用工具之前监控自我反思，以确保意图恰当。

chunks.content_en:
## 7 Conclusion

In this work, we present Reflexion, an approach that leverages verbal reinforcement to teach agents to learn from past mistakes. We empirically show that Reflexion agents significantly outperform currently widely-used decision-making approaches by utilizing self-reflection. In future work, Reflexion could be used to employ more advanced techniques that have been thoroughly studied in traditional RL settings, such as value learning in natural language or off-policy exploration techniques.
chunks.content_zh:
## 7 结论

在这项工作中，我们提出了 Reflexion，一种利用语言强化来教导智能体从过去的错误中学习的方法。我们通过实验表明，Reflexion 智能体通过利用自我反思（self-reflection），显著优于当前广泛使用的决策方法。在未来的工作中，Reflexion 可以用于采用传统强化学习（RL）环境中已被深入研究的更先进技术，例如自然语言中的价值学习或离线策略探索技术。

chunks.content_en:
## B.1 WebShop Limitation

In 5, we briefly state that Reflexion struggles to overcome local minima choices that require extremely creative behavior to escape. We observe this shortcoming in an experiment on WebShop [ 29]. WebShop is a web-based problem-solving benchmark that tests agents to navigate an e-commerce website to locate and purchase products given requests from clients. We test a two-shot ReAct + Reflexion agent in 100 environments.
chunks.content_zh:
## B.1 WebShop 局限性

在第5节中，我们简要指出 Reflexion 难以克服需要极强创造性行为才能摆脱的局部最优选择。我们在 WebShop [29] 上的一项实验中观察到这一不足。WebShop 是一个基于网页的问题求解基准，用于测试智能体（Agent）根据客户请求在电子商务网站上导航以查找并购买产品。我们在 100 个环境中测试了一个双样本（two-shot）ReAct + Reflexion 智能体。

chunks.content_en:
## B.1 WebShop Limitation

However, after only four trials, we terminate the runs as the agent does not show signs of improvement 6. Further, the agent does not generate helpful, intuitive self-reflections after failed attempts. We conclude that Reflexion is unable to solve tasks that require a significant amount of diversity and exploration. In AlfWorld, the agent is able to adequately explore new environments because the permissible actions can be seen in the observations.
chunks.content_zh:
## B.1 WebShop 局限性

然而，仅四次尝试后，我们就终止了运行，因为智能体没有表现出改善 6 的迹象。此外，该智能体在失败尝试后并未生成有帮助的、直观的自我反思。我们得出结论，Reflexion 无法解决需要大量多样性和探索的任务。在 AlfWorld 中，智能体能够充分探索新环境，因为允许的动作可以在观察中看到。

chunks.content_en:
## B.1 WebShop Limitation

In HotPotQA, the agent faces a similar WebShop search query task but is more successful as the search space for Wikipedia articles is more diverse and requires less precise search queries. A common problem for e-commerce search engines is properly handling ambiguity in natural language search interpretations. Thus, WebShop presents a task that requires very diverse and unique behavior from a Reflexion agent.
chunks.content_zh:
## B.1 WebShop 的局限性

在 HotPotQA 中，智能体面临类似的 WebShop 搜索查询任务，但成功率更高，因为 Wikipedia 文章的搜索空间更加多样，且对搜索查询的精确性要求较低。电子商务搜索引擎的一个常见问题是妥善处理自然语言搜索解释中的歧义。因此，WebShop 提出的任务要求 Reflexion 智能体表现出非常多样且独特的行为。
